companion_law: compliance-scorecard-v1.md (human-readable law; this file is the machine twin)

dimensions.name: Ritual completed
dimensions.plain_meaning: A valid activation receipt existed BEFORE work started
dimensions.ten_looks_like: Receipt timestamped before first work action; names session id, live-resolved main SHA, component SHAs, freshness window; cited in the work product; reviewer verified timestamp order
dimensions.why_it_matters: <required when score < 7: why the law requires it, in plain words>
dimensions.zero_looks_like: No receipt; or receipt timestamped after work started; or receipt SHA unresolvable on live main

dimensions.evidence: <location of the calculator block in the work product>
dimensions.name: Calculator used
dimensions.plain_meaning: Consequential decisions show objective, options, scores, and the winner picked by the numbers
dimensions.ten_looks_like: Objective stated; real options listed (no strawmen); each scored; winner chosen BY the math with percentages; visible in the artifact
dimensions.zero_looks_like: No options weighed; or options decorated a pre-made choice; or winner contradicts the seat's own scores

dimensions.name: Work shown
dimensions.plain_meaning: Reasoning is visible, not just conclusions; a cold successor could re-derive the result
dimensions.ten_looks_like: Intermediate reasoning visible; alternatives considered; ruled-out options explained; no trust-me steps
dimensions.zero_looks_like: Conclusions with no trail; DONE claimed with no proof the change landed

dimensions.evidence: <quote the plain-words summary, or note its absence>
dimensions.name: Plain words
dimensions.plain_meaning: A non-technical human can understand the report
dimensions.ten_looks_like: Summary explains what happened, what's going on, whether anyone should be concerned; jargon only with plain translations
dimensions.zero_looks_like: Reads like a machine log; a non-technical reader cannot tell what was done or whether it matters

dimensions.evidence: <the load-bearing claims and their sources, or name the sourceless ones>
dimensions.law_trace: OL-4.6 (Evidence Law), OL-8.3 (Proof must not exceed evidence), OL-4.7
dimensions.name: Evidence attached
dimensions.plain_meaning: Every load-bearing claim carries its source; uncertainty is labeled, never fabricated
dimensions.ten_looks_like: Claims cite file+line/blob SHA, PR number, comment id, or API output; unknowns labeled honestly; no score exceeds its evidence
dimensions.zero_looks_like: Sourceless claims; asserted certainty where nothing was measured; references that do not resolve

dimensions.evidence: <per named domain, one concrete trace ref, or 'no trace found'>
dimensions.law_trace: OL-5.3 (Law Is the Code), OL-5.4 (Scorecard Law)
dimensions.name: Right domains applied
dimensions.plain_meaning: The ritual's named law domains left visible traces in the work
dimensions.ten_looks_like: Each domain named in the ritual has a concrete trace in the work showing it changed what was done; un-named domains were correctly out of scope
dimensions.zero_looks_like: Domains named but invisible in the work; or no domains named at all (hollow ritual)

hard_rules: reviewer_seat MUST NOT equal doer_seat (Pair Model; self-scored cards are theater, not evidence)
every dimension score MUST carry an evidence string; a score with no evidence is rejected
any dimension score below 7 MUST carry correction and why_it_matters (the teaching loop)
scores are not rounded up: 7.95 is not 8.0
the unit enters the lock-in ledger ONLY when both compliance and quality scorecards exist

lock_in_metric.below_90: the miss report names the lowest-scoring dimension(s) across the window and opens the corrective loop
lock_in_metric.formula: lock_in_pct = 100 * (value-producing units in window) / (units in window)
lock_in_metric.low_sample_rule: fewer than 30 total units: use all units, flag the reading low-sample
publish: #1354 main feed, in the morning re-score message: lock-in %, window count, delta from prior day
BRAIN/01-GOVERNANCE/compliance-lock-in-ledger.jsonl — append-only; one object per unit; the ledger is the recomputable source of truth
lock_in_metric.window: last 30 scored work units (work-based, not time-based)

review_meta.reviewer_seat: <independent reviewing seat; must differ from doer_seat>

scopes.complements: BRAIN/01-GOVERNANCE/0003-SYSTEM-SCORECARD-V1.md (scores the WORK; this scores LAW ADHERENCE)
scopes.note: A work unit carries BOTH scorecards. Lawful but sloppy is not value; brilliant but lawless is not value.

totals.compliance_score: mean of the six dimension scores, 0-10 (no rounding up)
